recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-8044 unless Patient Care reopens a broader CommunicationRequest timing question, such as repeated Timing support or a newly required explicit comment.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive Patient Care DSTU1 change request to rename CommunicationRequest.scheduledTime to scheduled[x], allow dateTime or Period, and explain that a Period represents the time period within which the communication should occur.
initial_application: Git commit a452682b2a (#8044, #8198, #8466, #6251) applied the request by changing CommunicationRequest.scheduledTime to scheduled[x] and changing the type from dateTime to dateTime|Period in the then-authoritative spreadsheet source.
additional_context: Later Published/Persuasive workflow-alignment issue FHIR-10293 renamed CommunicationRequest.scheduled[x] to CommunicationRequest.occurrence[x] in commit 999f9323ad, preserved dateTime|Period, updated examples and search parameters, and left the active conversion mapping CommunicationRequest.scheduled=CommunicationRequest.occurrence in source/fhir.ini. A 2021 Zulip discussion confirmed CommunicationRequest.occurrence intentionally supports only dateTime or Period, not Timing for repeated reminders. Related FHIR-8198 came from the same original implementation commit and is already represented separately on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current active CommunicationRequest StructureDefinition contains occurrence[x] as 0..1 dateTime|Period with the scheduled-time definition, the current search parameter covers both dateTime and Period, and adding another Period-specific sentence would be redundant rather than necessary to implement FHIR-8044.

related_jiras.note: The same 2015 implementation commit also renamed CommunicationRequest.orderedOn to requestedOn; that issue is already represented separately on the combined branch.
Published Patient Care workflow alignment renamed scheduled[x] to occurrence[x] while preserving dateTime|Period.
